description: In this challenge, you and your chosen companion will be bound together, navigating the vast realms of Azeroth as an inseparable duo. From the moment you join forces, you'll be bonded by death, meaning if one of you dies, you both shall perish. Furthermore, you cannot leave the group, or you'll also instantly fail this challenge.
name: Duo

requirements.description: You must be in a party of |cffffffff2|r to attempt this challenge. If any party members fail their Trial, you will too.
requirements.name: Be in a party of 2
